behaviors.description: Isolated documented nullable previous_ids rebase variant.
expected: Public gtk-doc permits NULL previous_ids; addition succeeds and replacement installs before old uninstall.
Notification identifies retired ref and reason with NULL replacement; update deploys retired commit.
FALSE retains old update; TRUE adds rebase-and-uninstall and skips old update; exact signal payload and previous IDs.

behaviors.description: Rebase installation precedes uninstall; absent old ref is ignored.
expected: New app installs before old removal; repeat with absent old ref adds only new install.
Denied replacement payload prevents old uninstall and retains exact old commit.

behaviors.description: Cancel required payload after first byte while remainder is gated.
expected: Run returns FALSE and GError after synchronized cancellation; app A and runtime remain.

behaviors.description: Continue and stop after mandatory independent operation failure.
expected: FALSE stops before second operation; TRUE completes independent operation; failed deployment preserved.

behaviors.description: Earlier completed operation survives later payload failure.
expected: Exact completion order and commit remain deployed after later failure stops run.

behaviors.description: Failed and successful operation lifecycle payloads.
expected: Denied download begins then errors with mandatory-error details; retry begins then completes at B.

mappings.rationale: Reference exporter supplies known EOL metadata; exact emitted ref/reason checked both without replacement and with a non-NULL target, plus exact deployed EOL commits.

Both decisions inspect exact remote/ref/reason/replacement/previous IDs before any new-operation; FALSE updates old ref; TRUE calls public rebase-and-uninstall, installs replacement then uninstalls old ref with skipped original update.
Exact new-install then old-uninstall order and resulting state; repeat after removing new app while old remains absent proves omitted uninstall.
Required replacement payload denial causes new operation failure, no old uninstall execution, old exact commit preserved and replacement absent.
HTTP server sends one payload byte, records and publishes in-flight marker, gates remainder. C watcher cancels live run; require failure/GError and exact preserved A/runtime.

Probe resolved independent app order, deny unique payload of first operation, then test FALSE stops and TRUE runs remaining independent operation with exact done commit and persisted deployment. Failing operation GError and fatal details checked separately from outer error.
Deny unique payload of second resolved operation; first completes at exact B before failure, and remains publicly queryable at B after run fails.
Failed required B download emits exactly new then error with operation identity and GError; retry emits new then done with exact B commit, with C pointer/order checks.
